combo_label: Halloween × UK Sitcoms × The Wizard of Oz

entries.clue: Priest exiled to Craggy Island, adamant the missing money was merely resting
Small knobbly growth, stuck on a false nose to finish a hideous face
Turreted keep where red sand runs low while the witch's guards chant below
Yellow-brick way the lost girl is told to follow, and to keep on following
Careworn Kansas relation called Em, forever fretting over the girl and her dog
Yorkshire battleaxe of the wrinkled stockings, broom never far from hand
Green gem that gives the glittering city at the end of the bricks its name
Rusted, hollow fellow who creaks to a halt until his oil can is found
Dead crewman projected back aboard as a hologram, an H on his forehead
Braided cord at the heart of a taper, waiting for a match
Flat woollen cap, French by origin, worn above Frank Spencer's beige mac
Plucky little cairn terrier who leaps out of the basket and runs for home
Glowing by small flames alone, with every switch in the hallway left off
